title: Conan O’Brien Wants Jason Bateman to Be His Friend

sentences.en: Wanted to let you know I recently had your very own Jason Bateman on my podcast,
sentences.zh: 我想告诉大家，我最近把你们的杰森·贝特曼请到了我的播客上，
名字叫《柯南·奥布莱恩需要一个朋友》。

sentences.en: We talked about Jason's roots as a child star,
sentences.zh: 我们聊了聊杰森作为童星的出道经历，

sentences.en: his breakout role on Arrest Development, and of course, his fellow SmartList co-hosts,
sentences.zh: 他在《发展受阻》中的成名角色，当然还有他的 SmartList 黄金搭档，

sentences.en: Here's a little taste of what we got up to.
sentences.zh: 以下是我们节目内容的精彩片段。

sentences.en: You know, the question is, are you Conan O'Brien's friend if you aren't invited to his
sentences.zh: 你知道，问题在于，如果你没有被邀请去参加柯南的
圣诞派对，你还算得上是柯南·奥布莱恩的朋友吗？

sentences.en: You know, there's so many hundreds and hundreds of people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现场有成百上千的人。
我们已经把这事弄清楚了。

sentences.en: No, thousands are invited to the Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 不，有几千人被邀请参加圣诞派对。

sentences.en: I invite thousands and about 50 come.
sentences.zh: 我邀请了成千上万的人，大约有 50 人来了。

sentences.en: Listen, we're going to just, because this has been a thing,
sentences.zh: 听着，我们接下来要谈，因为这事之前闹得沸沸扬扬，

sentences.en: and then I went on SmartList recently, you know, about you coming to the Christmas party,
sentences.zh: 然后我最近上了 SmartList，你知道的，聊到了你来圣诞派对的事，

sentences.en: and it was a thing for a while.
I was shocked that there was a Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 我当时很震惊居然还有个圣诞派对。

sentences.en: The Christmas party had been going on for years.
sentences.zh: 这个圣诞派对已经举办好多年了。

sentences.en: But you were, I think you were shocked that Christmas was celebrated.
sentences.zh: 但你，我觉得你震惊的是居然还有人庆祝圣诞节。

sentences.en: That Christmas had something to do with your Lord and Savior, Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节居然和你的救世主耶稣基督有关。

sentences.en: Well, listen, the point is, you, you know, let's talk about SmartLiSt. It's a juggernaut.
sentences.zh: 好了，听着，重点是，你，你知道的，我们来聊聊 SmartList 吧。这可真是一档王牌节目。

sentences.en: I mean, that was a four-wheel slide.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这简直是个急转弯。

sentences.en: I just broke my hip pivoting.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚转话题把胯骨都闪了。

sentences.en: But no, the point I'm trying to make is, of you three guys, you got Will Arnett, you got Sean.
sentences.zh: 不过说真的，我想表达的重点是，你们这三个家伙里，有威尔·阿奈特，有肖恩。

sentences.en: And you're the one that I have trouble getting a beat on.
sentences.zh: 而你是我最摸不透的一个。

sentences.en: I got to say, you're the one, you're squirrely.
sentences.zh: 我得说，你就是那种人，你太滑头了。

sentences.en: I've always had a problem getting a beat on you.
sentences.zh: 我一直觉得很难摸清你的底细。

sentences.en: But I can't get a beat on the guy.
sentences.zh: 但我就是摸不透这家伙。

sentences.en: Because you can sense that I'm not sure why I'm there.
sentences.zh: 因为你能感觉到我不知道自己为什么会在那儿。

sentences.en: I'm not really sure if I...
sentences.zh: 我其实不太确定我是否...

sentences.en: I don't understand why people listen to it.
sentences.zh: 我不明白为什么人们会听这个。

sentences.en: I get that Will and Sean are appealing fellas.
sentences.zh: 我明白威尔和肖恩是很有魅力的家伙。

sentences.en: That's why they're two of my best friends.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，他们才是我最好的两个朋友。

sentences.en: And we're not doing anything more than just the drivel that happens when we're in a car together or at a dinner or how...
sentences.zh: 我们所做的不过就是当我们在车里、或者吃晚餐时那种胡侃，或者怎么...

sentences.en: I just don't think that that's monetizable.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这根本无法变现。

sentences.en: That you should ask for people's attention to listen to that.
sentences.zh: 你不该要求人们花心思去听那种内容。

sentences.en: I agree with it about your podcaSt. I agree because I've checked it out.
sentences.zh: 我赞同你对你的播客的看法。我赞同，因为我听过了。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I can't believe that this is something people...
sentences.zh: 然后我想，我真不敢相信这居然是人们...

sentences.en: I mean, this, what we're doing here...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这个，我们现在正在做的...

sentences.en: You've got an array of talent here.
Let me put my glasses on.
Even we would disagree with that.
sentences.zh: 连我们自己都不会同意这种说法。
你们有一个漂亮的演播室。

sentences.en: Also, can I just point out, I've been interviewing people around the clock since 1993.
sentences.zh: 另外，我能指出一点吗，我从1993年起就一直在连轴转地采访各种人。
我是个经验丰富的专业人士。

sentences.en: What Muhammad Ali was to boxing, I am to interviewing...
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·阿里对拳击意味着什么，我对于采访就意味着什么...

sentences.en: We can cut all this out.
But, yeah, you guys with this, you know, R&D...
sentences.zh: 但是，对，你们这群人，你知道，搞研发...

sentences.en: But, yes, but at least Will has just sharp dagger humor.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，至少威尔有着锋利的匕首般的幽默感。

sentences.en: He's got a darkness that's fun to follow.
sentences.zh: 他有一种引人入胜的黑暗特质。

sentences.en: A voice that's not bad to listen to.
I'd buy whatever truck he's selling.
I mean, as long as it's professional grade.
sentences.zh: 我是说，只要是专业级别的。

sentences.en: He's got an opinion and he'll let you know it.
sentences.zh: 他很有自己的见解，而且绝不藏着掖着。
简直就像纯粹的小太阳。

sentences.en: I'm trying to find the lane that I'm supposed to be in, which is the area in between those two,
sentences.zh: 我一直在寻找我该定位的角色，也就是介于这两者之间的那个区间，

sentences.en: which I guess is just sort of listening and asking questions that I think the normal guy wants to know.
sentences.zh: 我想那大概就是倾听，并问出一些我觉得普通观众会想知道的问题。

sentences.en: And so I feel I'm easily replaceable.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我其实挺容易被取代的。

sentences.en: I was going to say the same thing.
I was going to say, I'm glad you said it.
sentences.zh: 我本想说……幸亏你先说了。

sentences.en: You know, I think you could come, you could go.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我觉得你随时可以来，随时可以走。

sentences.en: Which is kind of what I do in whatever the hell I do on camera, too.
sentences.zh: 这其实也挺像我在镜头前不管搞什么鬼时做的事。

sentences.en: I'm trying to just kind of be us.
sentences.zh: 我只是试着做我们自己。

sentences.en: To hear the rest of the episode, as well as other great conversations I've had with folks like Amy Poehler, Adam Scott, Ben Stiller, and more,
sentences.zh: 想要收听本期节目的剩余内容，以及我和艾米·波勒、亚当·斯科特、本·斯蒂勒等嘉宾进行的精彩对话，

sentences.en: check out Conan O'Brien Needs a Friend wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台搜索并订阅《柯南·奥布莱恩需要一个朋友》。谢谢。
